metadata.title: World Digest — November 9, 2026
metadata.summary: As House Republicans push to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, stocks rallied sharply on easing AI fears, with the S&P 500 jumping 2.35% to 7,549.94.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Hegseth Impeachment Push Deepens GOP Turmoil

Rep. Thomas Massie introduced impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, forcing a House vote BBC. The move intensifies Republican infighting following devastating midterm losses Fox News.

Trump Questions Midterm Integrity, Sparks New Firestorm

President Trump revived baseless claims of rigged elections, questioning results in Mississippi and Alaska The New York Times. He also suggested his deportation policy "might have been too tough" for voters AP News.

Supreme Court Allows Border Wall Construction in Texas

The Supreme Court permitted the Trump administration to resume border wall construction in Big Bend, Texas CBS News. The ruling is a major win for a signature policy CBS News.

Senate GOP Delays Leadership Vote After "Worst Election Results"

Republican senators moved to postpone leadership elections, demanding reckoning after Democrats flipped the Senate Fox News. Sen. Dave McCormick called it the "worst election results in decades" Fox News.

Trial Date Set for Charlie Kirk's Accused Killer

A judge scheduled Tyler Robinson's murder trial for summer 2028 over the assassination of Charlie Kirk The Guardian. The case remains a national flashpoint The Guardian.

France Accuses Iran of Supermarket Fridge Hacking

French officials blamed Iran for cyber-sabotage attacks on supermarket refrigerators, vowing retaliation BBC. The incident escalates European-Iranian tensions BBC.

Poland Reels After Krakow Mass Shooting; Gunman Dies

The gunman who killed six in a Krakow square died in hospital, as thousands marched in mourning AP News. The rare shooting shocked the nation AP News.

FDA Orders Vision-Loss Warning on Popular GLP-1 Drugs

The FDA mandated new warnings on Ozempic and Zepbound over a rare eye condition linked to sudden blindness NBC News. The move affects millions of users NBC News.

OpenSSH Flaw Under Active Exploitation

A critical vulnerability letting hackers bypass SSH authentication on Linux devices is being actively exploited Ars Technica. An emergency fix has been issued Ars Technica.

James Gunn and Peter Safran Out at DC Studios

Post-merger, DC Studios replaced James Gunn and Peter Safran with Marvel veteran Jeremy Latcham Ars Technica. The shake-up throws DC's film universe into flux Ars Technica.

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Hegseth Impeachment Push

Rep. Thomas Massie filed articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth NPR, who was also accused of blocking military promotions over COVID shots and Pride events Military.com. The move came as Congress returned to a changed Washington after the GOP’s election wipeout Baton Rouge Business Report.

Germany’s First Female President

Friedrich Merz nominated Ilse Aigner as Germany’s first female president, with governing parties uniting behind the Bavarian conservative Financial Times AP News.

Iran Fridge Hacking Accusation

France formally accused Iran of orchestrating an “unprecedented” cyberattack on supermarket refrigerators, vowing retaliation BBC.

Krakow Shooting Suspect Dies

The Polish gunman who killed six in Krakow square died in a hospital AP News.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets Slide as Tech Woes Deepen

Global equities fell as AI-related jitters persisted, with a key chip index breaking a long-term trendline Bloomberg.com. Oil dropped to a 10-week low after reports suggested Iran eased Hormuz demands Bloomberg.com. Domestically, gas prices neared $4 for the first time since July CNN.

Corporate News - Boeing will cut 5% of its commercial airplane workforce The Seattle Times. - Tesla will refund some Cybertruck deposits, ending production TechCrunch. - Lucid missed earnings and expanded its Saudi loan facility CNBC. - Children's Place filed for bankruptcy Reuters.

Other Headlines - FDA ordered new eye-risk warnings for GLP-1 drugs NBC News. - Anthropic launched new Claude models The Verge. - NASA awarded $10 billion in Moon Base contracts Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content:
Entertainment

DC Studios is reeling after James Gunn and Peter Safran's exit, with Marvel alum Jeremy Latcham taking the reins post-merger Ars Technica. The literary world made history as M. John Harrison became the first sci-fi author to win the Booker Prize The New York Times. Paul McCartney joined the billionaire ranks, becoming the world's third-richest musician Variety. In music, Ye broke his own U.S. rap concert record with 83,132 fans Variety. Rock guitarist Richard Lloyd, of Television, has died at 75 PennLive.com.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Football

Houston Texans 44, Los Angeles Chargers 22 – C.J. Stroud threw five touchdown passes as the Texans routed the winless Chargers, who finally scored their first touchdown of the season. ESPN

Green Bay Packers 45, New England Patriots 27 – Jordan Love accounted for four touchdowns and Green Bay forced four turnovers in a statement win. ESPN

San Francisco 49ers 38, Las Vegas Raiders 17 – Five second-half takeaways powered the 49ers past the Raiders. ESPN

Basketball

Los Angeles Lakers 121, Detroit Pistons 116 – Austin Reaves stepped in for Luka Dončić, pouring in 43 points. ESPN

Boston Celtics 117, Milwaukee Bucks 97 – Paul George and Jayson Tatum led Boston over the slumping Bucks. ESPN

Miami Heat 114, Sacramento Kings 108 – Giannis Antetokounmpo, the subject of trade buzz ESPN, scored 29 as the Heat won, though Miami's rocky start remains a concern ESPN.

Hockey

Winnipeg Jets 4, Tampa Bay Lightning 3 – Mark Scheifele scored on the power play with 1.6 seconds left. ESPN

Soccer

Manchester United's relegation battle could lead to hiring U.S. coach Mauricio Pochettino. ESPN

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

No new pricings on 2026-11-09. Upcoming listings include SPACCircle Acquisition (Nasdaq, 11-10) and Deep Sea Minerals (Nasdaq, 11-10) Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

Stocks surged: S&P 500 +2.35% to 7,549.94, Nasdaq +2.74% to 25,253.14, Dow +2.15% to 52,389.75, Russell 2000 +3.15% Yahoo Finance. VIX plunged 22.31% to 19.92, signaling eased fear Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Industrials led (+3.82%), followed by Technology (+3.73%) Yahoo Finance. Energy lagged, rising just +0.52%, with Consumer Staples +0.90% Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Broadcom jumped +8.78%; Tesla +5.54% and Meta +5.12% Yahoo Finance. Nvidia fell 4.27%, bucking the rally, despite being most active Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Gainers: Fervo Energy +26.1%, Praxis Precision +19.9%, QXO +19.2% Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Losers: ACADIA -22.3%, Ionis -21.4% Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Intel +5.5% among actives Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield edged up to 4.86% Yahoo Finance. WTI crude fell 4.90% to $86.38; gold rose 1.83% to $4,149.50; bitcoin +0.62% to $75,048.88 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
24–48 Hours

  • House vote on Hegseth impeachment articles; outcome signals GOP fracture depth post-midterms.
  • Market watch: Nvidia's slide vs. broad rally may define AI sentiment; VIX at 19.92 suggests residual fragility.

Next Week

  • Senate GOP leadership election delay could yield public factional battles.
  • Watch for European retaliation specifics against Iran after fridge-hacking accusation.

Next Month

  • GLP-1 vision-loss warnings may trigger regulatory ripple effects across pharma.
  • DC Studios leadership transition could reshape superhero film slate; Poland's gunman death may fuel policy debate.
